Bundled FFmpeg runtime of the Windows client (1.0.0.7): n6.1.4
Source commit: 34277e12e80031c7f89494ba543684bc1dd0be8f
Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
The matching unmodified source snapshot is ffmpeg-n6.1.4-source.tar.xz (SHA-256
735b0713aa8f7218b1f77bf0407d6db6c9c4dde77d75f2e9e2d19f9b5c46ef55), the same as the Bazzite client's.

Built on Linux with mingw-w64 (GCC 13, win32 thread model) by scripts/Build-FFmpeg-Windows.sh.
Configure arguments (also recorded in the libraries; see avcodec_configuration()):
--prefix=/ffmpeg --target-os=mingw32 --arch=x86_64 --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32-
--enable-cross-compile --pkg-config=false --enable-shared --disable-static --disable-programs
--disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-everything --enable-avcodec --enable-avutil --enable-swscale
--disable-avformat --disable-avdevice --disable-avfilter --disable-swresample --disable-postproc
--disable-network --enable-decoder=h264,hevc,av1 --enable-parser=h264,hevc,av1
--enable-hwaccel=h264_d3d11va,h264_d3d11va2,hevc_d3d11va,hevc_d3d11va2,av1_d3d11va,av1_d3d11va2
--enable-d3d11va --enable-vulkan --disable-dxva2 --enable-w32threads --disable-pthreads
--extra-cflags='-Ivulkan-headers -O2' --extra-ldflags='-static-libgcc -Wl,--no-insert-timestamp'

vulkan-headers/ is a copy of the Khronos Vulkan headers (1.3.255 or later; Apache-2.0 or MIT), placed beside
the source for the build only; nothing of them is compiled into the libraries beyond declarations.

The Windows client decodes with D3D11VA on the GPU that SteamVR uses, and copies each picture into the
Vulkan frame pass that also serves the Bazzite client; the Vulkan hardware context creates that device.
FFmpeg's native AV1 decoder decodes only through hardware acceleration (no software AV1 decoder is
included), so AV1 needs a GPU with AV1 decoding. CPU decoding (troubleshooting) covers H.264 and HEVC.

No source changes were made. No GPL or non-free components were enabled; the configure result is
LGPL 2.1 or later. The libraries link KERNEL32, msvcrt and bcrypt only (libgcc is linked statically).
These are shared libraries (avcodec-60.dll, avutil-58.dll, swscale-7.dll) and can be replaced with
compatible rebuilt versions.
